page.layout: One page of text in verse, set in italic, with a page number at the top right and a gathering signature below the text. No marginal notes. A woodcut ornament sits at the foot, not transcribed.

l.i: Hunc lana vestit quam proprij ferunt
Et fronde replet. Sic facili orbita

page.notes: The ornament at the foot of the page is a woodcut fleuron, not text. The line-final mark after "dape" is a printed stroke, read as a full stop. Spellings are copied as printed; "Gestare" and "Hunc" are read with confidence, but the long s is taken as s throughout.
